`flutter_app/assets/opening_t2s.json` and
`Dashboard/static/data/opening_t2s.json` are generated from OpenCC's
`TSCharacters.txt` dictionary. Each entry uses the first one-character
simplified mapping, omitting identity entries. The files have been sorted and
encoded as JSON for client use.
